positive: Starting a new session, check whether GODMODE-CODE-OF-LAW.md exists at the project root and read it.
Follow the guards in the project's compiled Code of Law before acting on a new task.
near_negative: Draft a fresh guard for behavior nobody has ever corrected.
Retire an old lesson and write a fresh guard from a blank slate.

behavior_assertions.assert: The compiled law file, when present, is read before substantive work begins.

behavior_assertions: A guard that seems wrong is named and its underlying lesson retired rather than silently ignored.
